report.title: Teardown: LangGraph, CrewAI and AutoGen - graph abstraction versus role abstraction
report.question_or_target: What does each framework make easy that the other two make hard (typed state graphs, role/crew delegation, conversational group chat), and which of those abstractions is transferable to a prompt-native control plane WITHOUT importing a second orchestration runtime?
report.evidence_requirement_verbatim: two mechanically independent signals per load-bearing claim (rules/common/single-signal-verification.md); every claim carries source lineage (resolved URL + fetch timestamp + sha256 of the fetched bytes), a Sherman-Kent confidence band, and a named independent verification path (_USER-PROMPTS.md:10717); each transfer verdict names the mechanism separately from the runtime that hosts it, and states the concrete reimplementation cost on our control plane
tests_required: negative control: at least one abstraction must be judged NOT transferable without the runtime, with the specific runtime service it depends on named
negative control that can go red: mutate every NOT_TRANSFERABLE_WITHOUT_RUNTIME verdict to TRANSFERABLE_WITHOUT_SECOND_RUNTIME and require the transfer-boundary detector to exit nonzero

ease_rubric.EASY: Dedicated documented API and matching implementation class; user supplies domain logic but not the scheduler/merge/delegation/speaker loop named by the feature.
ease_rubric.HARDER: Expressible by composing lower-level primitives or custom policy in the audited flagship surface; never interpreted as impossible.
ease_rubric.comparison_scope: Official docs fetched at the recorded timestamps and implementation sources pinned to the recorded immutable commits.

answer.short: LangGraph is strongest at typed state graphs, CrewAI at role/crew delegation, and AutoGen at conversational speaker-managed teams. Transfer the declarative cores, not their runtimes: add state/reducer/transition data, bounded role profiles/delegation receipts, and a conversation-ledger selector to the existing control plane. Do not claim LangGraph-equivalent durability or AutoGen distributed delivery without their Pregel/Checkpointer or AgentRuntime host/worker services.
adopt: typed state schema + reducers + explicit transitions
message ledger + candidate filter + speaker selector + termination gate
